[LSMP.2.3] Aggregations over the bag use only correctly-rounded IEEE-754
operations (`+ − × ÷ √`), taken over the bag's slots in order 0 to $n-1$
([LSMP.2.1]) and in the order [LSER.16.3.3] gives for `sample`, so the computed
values are cross-platform bit-exact ([LDET.3.4]). Queries are read-only.
